apis.description: The caller's Dropbox, read through the Dropbox API v2 with the caller's own access token. The declaration carries no credential: the Authorization header is the ${DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN} placeholder, expanded from the environment when the declaration is loaded, so the token itself is never written into a file. Dropbox API v2 is RPC over POST, so methods is set deliberately — every operation in the shipped document is a read (list, search, metadata, account); no upload, download or write endpoint is declared.
apis.name: dropbox
